args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! We're so glad to have you joining the marketing team next week.

I'm Emma Johnson, and I wanted to reach out with a warm welcome before you arrive. I'm confident you'll be a great addition to the team, and I know everyone is looking forward to working with you.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything I can help you with in the meantime — whether it's setting up your accounts, getting oriented, or simply answering questions about how we work.

Looking forward to welcoming you on board!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
